_provenance: X API v2 400 invalid-request naming the pagination cursor as the rejected parameter (a stale or mangled `pagination_token` handed back as `page_token`). The envelope is the documented invalid-request problem body (same shape as 400-unmapped.json); the per-parameter entry follows the documented `errors[].parameters` + `message` form with the cursor as the parameter. Source: docs.x.com/x-api/fundamentals/errors invalid-request. Modelled, not a live capture. Exercises: PAGE-2 — the one API-returned 400 that maps to `validation`, not `api`. Authored 2026-09-23.

body.title: Invalid Request
body.detail: One or more parameters to your request was invalid.

errors.message: The `pagination_token` query parameter value [cursor==stale] is not valid
